region.name: Ozello
region.text: Where the Panhandle bends into the peninsula, the coast turns to marsh and there is very little development. Life here is springs, rivers, scalloping and fishing, in towns like Cedar Key, Crystal River and Steinhatchee.

towns.name: Ozello
towns.watch: Very low lying and floods in storms. One winding road in and out
towns.blurb: A handful of homes on marsh islands at the end of a nine mile winding road. About as remote as the Gulf coast gets.
towns.day: You launch a kayak from the back yard, fish the oyster bars and don't see another boat all morning.
todo: A twisting road through salt marsh and hammocks that's a destination by itself.
towns.area_name: The Nature Coast and Big Bend
